No contract status changes anywhere in the repository.
Contracts with a co-owner are routed to that co-owner rather than proposed for promotion by A0 alone.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped.

security_privacy_cost_impact: data classification synthetic-only; secrets required false; network policy deny-unless-declared. No provider call, credential, migration or customer-data effect. Cost impact none: no metered resource is touched.
compatibility_impact: None. One guard suite's temporary-directory handling. The sweep now removes only copies whose owning process is gone, so a run no longer deletes a concurrent run's repository mid-test.

The freeze check establishes presence, not sufficiency. Four items are named in the RFC where a script cannot see what the phrase meant: stable ordering, auth rules, decimal money and bounded cardinality.
CTR-NTF-001 remains unassessed; A5 owns it.

A SHA-256 digest can contain a Luhn-valid 13-to-19 digit run by coincidence, and test-kits/integrity-manifest.json is a file of 83 such digests rewritten whenever any protected file changes. This branch was first spelled `WP-0A-CON-008-sweep-age-floor`; the resulting digest of work-packages/WP-0A-CON-008.json contained a Visa-shaped 13-digit run that scan-repository-secrets.mjs correctly reported as a payment card number. It was a false positive with no data behind it, and there is no allowlist to silence one -- deliberately, per that scanner's own comments. The branch was renamed to `WP-0A-CON-008-pid-reuse-age-floor` to change the digest, which is a workaround and not a fix: roughly one regenerated digest in a few hundred will trip this again, on any package, for reasons having nothing to do with that package's work. The scanner is outside this package's writable paths and an exemption there is explicitly reserved for a reviewed decision with a named owner. The offending run is not reproduced here, because that rule is not prose-exempt and quoting it fails the scan -- which this entry established by doing it. Recorded so the next author finds a diagnosis, not a mystery.

reviewer_instructions: Read evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/ first: it records what was verified, what was refused and why, and the independent findings that corrected this package.

Ten independent verification runs were dispatched against this stack. The first eight each shipped an untested business rule past every guard; the ninth and tenth could not, after roughly 22,000 and 9,350 mutations respectively, but each still found real defects elsewhere. Assume an eleventh exists.
Attack the guards rather than reading them. Every defect found so far came from execution and none from reading.
The author is /claude/a0_atlas. Reviewer, tester and integration verification are open and must be distinct runs; cross-vendor review is not satisfied and is carried as a recorded exception.

For this increment read evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/handoff-base-revision.md, then restore scripts/refresh-author-handoff.mjs from an earlier revision and run node --test test-kits/handoff-conformance.test.mjs: two of the three new cases must fail and the in-progress case must pass against both implementations. A test that cannot be made to fail is not evidence.
